description: Propose study blocks for everything due in the next N days: estimates the hours each item needs, then spreads them over the days before each deadline inside your study hours, around your Canvas calendar. Read-only; use schedule_study_plan to put the blocks on your calendar.

block_minutes.description: Length of each study block in minutes. Default 60.

day_end.description: Latest study time each day, 24-hour "HH:MM". Default "21:00".

day_start.description: Earliest study time each day, 24-hour "HH:MM". Default "16:00".

days.description: How many days ahead to plan. Default 14.

max_hours_per_day.description: Most study hours per day. Default 3.

skip_weekends.description: If true, plan nothing on Saturdays and Sundays.

name: study_plan
title: Study Plan
